issues.passage: He filed the ephemeral records in a permanent archive meant to preserve them indefinitely.
issues.why: "Ephemeral records/materials" is standard, correct usage for short-lived documents (memos, flyers, etc.) that archives routinely collect. Filing them for long-term preservation does not make the adjective a misuse of ephemeral = lasting only a short time; a student who knows the word could rightly accept this passage.

fix.correctPassage: The desert bloom is ephemeral, vanishing within days once the rains end.
wrongPassages: Stone monuments are ephemeral because they outlast the civilizations that raised them.
Their ephemeral collaboration has produced books together for more than thirty years.
He called the century-old oak ephemeral, noting that it had shaded the square for generations.
